biotools.summary: The SFTS Severity Nomogram is a tool developed to predict the severity of severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) patients at admission based on clinical variables. It utilizes a dynamic nomogram built from LASSO logistic regression and is accessible as a Shiny app.
